- **稳定元素引用** — 可点击元素使用 `[N]`，可输入元素使用 `<N>`，视觉元素使用 `[view:ID]`。
- **Session 隔离** — 每个 "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"DSH Agent 独立拥有浏览器进程、标签页、CDP 会话和 DOM 缓存。
- **多标签页与滚动探索** — 支持创建、切换、关闭标签页，以及按屏或按页面位置探索长页面。
- **DSH 原生生"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"命周期** — 使用 Cordis、`defineTool`、approval、取消信号和 attachment 服务，不依赖兼容服务器。

| C"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"onduct multi-step research | Manually copy content at every step | Continue exploration across tabs "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"|
| Understand page changes | Re-read the full page repeatedly | Prefer DOM diffs and establish a fu"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"ll baseline when needed |
| Inspect charts and images | Text-only information | Capture visual eleme"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"nts as DSH attachments |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Core features"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **Real Chromium** — Controls local Chrome/Chromium instead of simulating a page or performing an H"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"TTP-only fetch.
